prompt: Preciso de dados sobre tarifas comerciais de países da OCDE no período 2000-2010. Veja se tem algo no Harvard Dataverse ou em outra base acadêmica.
assertions: At least 2 alternative data sources are presented with pros/cons or ranking
A Python download script exists for the recommended primary source
SOURCES.yaml exists and contains required fields: id, name, provider, url, license, date_accessed
DATA_DICTIONARY.md exists and documents tariff-related variables
If any source requires credentials, .env.example documents how to obtain them
